BSC37-010.name: No No! Don't Come Here
BSC37-010.effect:
[Type: Song]

[Flash]
During this turn, all "Diva" family Spirits you control gain +5000 BP, and can block while exhausted. Or, during this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack. Then, you can put this card onto your Field.

BSC37-X01.name: ［Black Heaven Princess］Nei-Lanetail
BSC37-X01.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

When your [Twilight Gothic] Spirit has left the Field due to an opposing effect, you can summon this card from Hand without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

[LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Discard an opposing Burst. Also, if it's your Attack Step, this Spirit can't be blocked.

BSC37-003.name: ［Airy Dancer］Fongneena
BSC37-003.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
When summoned via the effect of your "Fongneena", put three cores from the Void to any "Diva" family Spirits you control.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
During this turn, all your "Fongneena" can't be blocked, and while your "Fongneena" is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

PB16-D01.name: ［Christmas Party］Rei-Ohba
PB16-D01.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can summon a Brave card and a "Stage Style" family Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Christmas Party"-named Spirits can't be blocked by opposing Spirits.

BSC37-009.name: ［Crimson Dress］Sandy-Z-Leonora
BSC37-009.effect:
[teams: Grand Siesta Shiny Hearts]

When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand. When you've done so, return a Cost 8 "Grand Style" family Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can draw a card from the deckbottom. Also, if your Life is five or less, put a core from any of your "Producer" Grandwalker Nexuses to the Life.

BSC37-004.name: ［Diva of Heaven and Earth］Zexia Tenma
BSC37-004.effect:
[team: Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, this Spirit can refresh.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.
[Diva Rush: 3/4]
While you control three or more Spirits with different team names, opposing Spirits can't refresh.
While you control four or more Spirits with different team names, your Spirits can't be blocked.

BSC37-XX01.name: ［Divine Star Goddess］Noa Fleur
BSC37-XX01.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. When summoned via your "Diva" family Spirit effect, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
You can return an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit to the deckbottom. Then, for each two "Stage Style" family Spirits you control, send an opposing Life to the Reserve (Max. 2).

PX14-09.name: ［Eternal Idol］Noa Fleur
PX14-09.effect:
[team: Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Summon any number of "Diva" family Spirit cards from your Hand, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of the Spirits can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] 2 (When Attacks)
By arranging two refreshed "Diva" family Spirits you control to both sides of this Spirit, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 10000 BP.

BSC37-X03.name: ［Everyone's Diva］Trickster
BSC37-X03.effect:
This card/Spirit has every Team.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can return three opposing Spirits to the Hand. For each Spirit returned by this effect, draw a card.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
You can pay one cost to summon a "Stage Style"/"Grand Style" family Spirit card from your Hand. When you've done so, once per turn, refresh this Spirit.

BSC37-005.name: ［Fallen War Princess］Sierra Murceine
BSC37-005.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

When this card is revealed from deck by your [Twilight Gothic] Spirit effect, you can add it to the Hand.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 5([Yellow Core][Yellow Core])]
Return an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it to the deckbottom. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit with three cores or less on it to the deckbottom.

BSC37-007.name: ［Never Hesitate Again］Riolu Tida
BSC37-007.effect:
[teams: Pretty Animals Shiny Hearts]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If it's "Riolu Tida"/"Rias Urovorun", you can summon it without paying the cost. Add any remaining card to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP, and is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

BSC37-002.name: ［Sacred Sword Idol］Jakomina Kit
BSC37-002.effect:
[teams: Absolutes Sacred Swords]

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Besides "Jakomina Kit", you can summon a [Sacred Swords] Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost. When you've done so, return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2]
[Sacred Swords] Spirits you control are unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.

LM16-D05.name: ［Sacred Swords］Daiya Lune
LM16-D05.effect:
[teams: Pretty Animals Sacred Swords]

[LV1][LV2] 1 (When Attacks)
By arranging one refreshed "Diva" family Spirit you control on the right side of this Spirit, draw a card from the deckbottom.

LM16-D02.name: ［Sacred Swords］Griffiar d'Arc
LM16-D02.effect:
[teams: Shiny Hearts Sacred Swords]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
For each [Sacred Swords] Spirit you control, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. For each Spirit returned to the Hand by this effect, put a core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
During this turn, give all opposing Spirits -3000 BP.

P16-17.name: ［Sacred Swords］Jakomina Kit
P16-17.effect:
[teams: Absolutes Sacred Swords]

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add an [Absolutes] or [Sacred Swords] Spirit card to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards. If [Soul Core] was used to pay the summon cost, instead, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

LM16-D04.name: ［Sacred Swords］Jeanne Doraniece
LM16-D04.effect:
[teams: Twilight Gothic Sacred Swords]

When your "Rei-Ohba" is summoned, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
If you control no Spirits/Ultimates except this one and one "Rei-Ohba", return every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Hand.

LM16-D03.name: ［Sacred Swords］Nei-Lanetail
LM16-D03.effect:
[teams: Twilight Gothic Sacred Swords]

When your [Twilight Gothic]/[Sacred Swords] Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can summon a Cost 7 or less [Twilight Gothic]/[Sacred Swords] Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

LM16-D01.name: ［Sacred Swords］Rei-Ohba
LM16-D01.effect:
[teams: Shiny Hearts Sacred Swords]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your [Shiny Hearts]/[Sacred Swords] Spirits can't be blocked by opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If you control five or more differently named [Sacred Swords] Spirits, return five opposing Spirits to the deckbottom.

BSC37-X02.name: ［Rei-san Lock On］Jeanne Doraniece
BSC37-X02.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit. Then, you can return all "Rei-Ohba" from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When your Field has no Spirits/Ultimates other than this Spirit and a Cost 7 or more "Rei-Ohba", after this turn ends, your turn occurs, and at the End Step of the extra turn, you lose the game.

BSC37-001.name: ［Savior Diva］Banri-Zell
BSC37-001.effect:
[teams: Shiny Hearts Hyakka Ryouran]

[Burst: s] (After an opposing Spirit attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Life, and summon this card without paying the cost. Then, by summoning a "Banri" Spirit card from your Trash without paying the cost, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
By sending a core from your Life to the Trash, this Spirit can't be blocked.

BSC37-008.name: ［Winter Attire］Saclaire Metum
BSC37-008.effect:
[teams: Grand Siesta Absolutes]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
During this turn, you can give an opposing Spirit -3000 BP. This effect activates for a number of times equal to the number of [Grand Siesta] Spirits you control, and destroys if reaches 0 BP.

[LV3]
Besides [Soul Core], all cores on the Spirits destroyed by this Spirit's effect are sent to the Trash instead of the Reserve.

BSC37-006.name: ［Witch Quartet Noir］Flamme Sandria
BSC37-006.effect:
[team: Twilight Gothic]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
For each "Witch Quartet"-named Spirit you control, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
If your Field has six or more [Song] Magic cards, during the next opposing Refresh Step, the opponent can't return any cores, except [Soul Core], from their Trash to the Reserve. This effect can only be used once per game.
